Situated on one of the main streets of the Old Quarter, our hotel offers the rare advantage of a spacious, easily accessible location while keeping you just steps away from the charm of Hanoi’s historic lanes. Only a short stroll from Hoan Kiem Lake, we place you within easy reach of the city’s iconic attractions, colorful markets, and vibrant nightlife. Inside, discover an array of experiences without ever leaving the property – rejuvenate at Pal Spa, savor creative cuisine and handcrafted cocktails at Pal Bar & Restaurant, and unwind in our cozy, elegantly appointed rooms. With a dedicated and youthful team committed to warm, attentive service, your stay with us promises both relaxation and a deep connection to the spirit of Hanoi. Discover the Heart of Hanoi with Palago Boutique. At Palago Boutique Hanoi Hotel & Spa, every stay is more than just a place to sleep – it’s an invitation to immerse yourself in the charm, culture, and flavors of Hanoi’s Old Quarter. From our spacious location on Bát Đàn Street to the refined comforts of our rooms, we blend local heritage with modern elegance. Whether you’re here to explore the bustling markets, unwind at Pal Spa, or enjoy crafted cocktails at Pal Bar & Restaurant, our youthful and dedicated team ensures every moment is memorable. book now palago experieces What do customers ask? Frequently asked Questions What makes our hotel different from others in the city? We blend boutique charm with modern comfort — from personalized service to unique local design, every detail is crafted to make your stay unforgettable How close is the hotel to Hanoi’s top attractions? We’re just a 5-minute walk to Hoàn Kiếm Lake, a short stroll to the Old Quarter’s bustling streets, and only 10 minutes by car to major cultural landmarks like the Temple of Literature. Can I request special room decorations for birthdays, anniversaries, or proposals? Absolutely! Our team loves helping you celebrate. Let us know in advance, and we’ll prepare a surprise that fits your occasion. Do you offer any local experience packages? Yes! We can arrange city tours, cooking classes, spa treatments, and hidden-gem excursions curated by locals. Can I work remotely from the hotel? Definitely. We have high-speed Wi-Fi, comfortable workspaces, and even in-room Netflix breaks for when you need to recharge.
